verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Feed API that maps and syncs merchant product data, including real-time catalog and inventory, to AI platforms such as OpenAI and Meta. Its ACP/UCP checkout sessions return totals and fulfillment options, and the Cart API supports live price and stock checks, so offer data is exposed to agents in structured form. However, the feed is pushed to platforms rather than shown as directly readable for any listed product, and variants and checkout links are not evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented read/query endpoint for offer data, explicit variant and checkout-link fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.
